title: An upload limit grows, and the user guide states the old size in prose

pr.title: Raise the upload limit to 25 MB
pr.description: MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES goes from 10 MB to 25 MB. New tests cover the limit.

bugs.note: docs/user-guide.md still says that a file of up to 10 MB uploads. The change raises the limit to 25 MB, so a reader of the guide thinks that a file of 10 to 25 MB fails. The guide names neither MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES nor checkSize, so a search for the changed symbol misses it. Update the size in the guide.

traps.why: checkSize throws only when bytes > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, so a file of exactly 25 MB uploads. A finding that this test must expect a throw is wrong.
